catalog_scope: Lightweight hazard-based traceability for existing deterministic runtime mechanisms; not runtime authorization or certification.

hazards.title: Unsafe Base Motion with Unsafe Manipulator State
hazards.description: AGV motion is dispatched while an arm is not explicitly known to be in its transport-safe state.
hazards.unsafe_control_action: Dispatch move_agv when either required arm transport-safety precondition is false or unknown.
hazards.safety_property: Base motion MUST NOT be dispatched unless every required arm transport state is explicitly safe.
assumptions: The current unified RobotState arm-safe fields represent the available transport-state observation.

hazards.title: Motion Authorized from Unknown or Stale Safety State
hazards.description: Motion is admitted from an unknown emergency-stop value or from a state snapshot older than the active skill contract permits.
hazards.unsafe_control_action: Admit or dispatch a motion skill using unknown or contract-stale safety state.
hazards.safety_property: Motion admission and dispatch MUST require explicitly safe state values and MUST satisfy every configured state-freshness limit.
assumptions: RobotState.timestamp is a snapshot-level timestamp; per-signal emergency-stop timestamps remain future work.

hazards.title: False Physical Commit
hazards.description: A command receipt or incomplete, invalid, stale, or mismatching evidence is treated as proof of physical completion.
hazards.unsafe_control_action: Enter COMMITTED without satisfying every required physical-evidence condition.
hazards.safety_property: Transactions MUST NOT enter COMMITTED without complete, valid, sufficiently fresh required physical evidence that matches expected effects.

hazards.title: Duplicate Non-Idempotent Physical Side Effect
hazards.description: A dispatched or committed non-idempotent action is sent again by retry or continuation replanning.
hazards.unsafe_control_action: Redispatch a non-idempotent or unknown-idempotency action after the dispatch boundary without a committed outcome, or replay a committed action.
hazards.safety_property: Non-idempotent or UNKNOWN-idempotency transactions that crossed DISPATCHED MUST NOT be blindly redispatched when uncommitted, and COMMITTED actions MUST NOT be replayed.

hazards.title: Unsupported Capability Dispatch
hazards.description: A planner-requested skill absent from the active backend capability set reaches backend dispatch.
hazards.unsafe_control_action: Admit or dispatch a skill not supported by the active backend and runtime registry.
hazards.safety_property: Only skills explicitly supported by the active backend and present in the active registry MUST be eligible for admission.

hazards.title: Logical STOP Without Safe-stop Attempt
hazards.description: Execution reports STOP without attempting the backend safe-stop operation or loses its independent result.
hazards.unsafe_control_action: Return a STOP decision while omitting or duplicating the backend safe-stop attempt.
hazards.safety_property: Every STOP report MUST attempt backend safe-stop exactly once and MUST preserve both the original failure and the independent stop result.

hazards.title: Invalid Numeric Command or Evidence
hazards.description: NaN or infinite numeric values cross command validation or are accepted as physical evidence.
hazards.unsafe_control_action: Dispatch a command with non-finite numeric parameters or commit using non-finite required evidence.
hazards.safety_property: Numeric command parameters and required numeric physical evidence MUST be finite before dispatch or COMMITTED.

hazards.title: Missing Safety Contract
hazards.description: A newly registered skill without an explicit complete safety contract is treated as executable.
hazards.unsafe_control_action: Admit a skill whose safety contract is absent or incomplete.
hazards.safety_property: Skills without an explicit complete safety contract MUST NOT enter ADMITTED or DISPATCHED.
